title: Employment Arbitration Agreement

title: WARN Act Layoff Notice

title: Company Property & Equipment Return Acknowledgment

title: Direct Deposit Authorization

title: Employee Referral Bonus Agreement

title: Written Warning / Corrective Action Notice
description: Documents a performance or conduct issue, sets expectations going forward, and confirms this notice doesn't change at-will status.

title: New Hire Onboarding Checklist
description: What gets completed before or on a new hire's start date, including Form I-9 work-authorization verification.

title: Exit Interview Form
description: A short set of standard departure-feedback questions.

title: Employment Verification Letter
description: A short letter confirming someone's employment — the classic "proof of employment" letter requested by landlords, lenders, and others.

title: Timesheet / Time Records
description: A weekly time record, plus the federal recordkeeping rule behind why non-exempt hours have to be tracked.

title: Overtime Authorization Form
description: A simple advance-approval request for overtime hours, plus the federal rule on paying for overtime an employer knew about even without pre-approval.

title: PTO / Vacation Request Form
description: A simple paid-time-off request and approval form.

title: Business Expense Reimbursement Form
description: An itemized expense list with an employee certification and manager approval.

title: Salary Change / Promotion Notice
description: A short notice documenting a title or salary change.

title: Job Description Template
description: A simple fill-in template for a job posting or internal job description.

title: Interview Scorecard
description: A short candidate-evaluation form for interviewers to fill out after each interview.

title: Anti-Harassment & Non-Discrimination Policy
description: The federal prohibition on workplace harassment and discrimination, how it's reported and investigated, the real legal reason a written policy and prompt response matter, and the separate protection against retaliation.

title: FMLA Leave Request & Employer Notice
description: Who's eligible for FMLA leave, what it covers (including the separate military-family leave categories), the leave request itself, restoration rights on return, and the separate protection against interference or retaliation.

title: ADA Reasonable Accommodation Request Form
description: A request for a workplace accommodation, the employer's duty to engage in the interactive process in good faith, the undue-hardship limit on that duty, and the confidentiality of any medical information shared to support the request.

title: Exempt / Non-Exempt Classification Notice
description: The federal overtime default, the actual three-part test a position has to meet to be classified exempt, and the classification decision itself.

title: Pregnant Workers Fairness Act Accommodation Request
description: A pregnancy-related accommodation request under a 2023 federal law distinct from the ADA — it doesn't require the limitation to rise to the level of a disability.

title: Employee Non-Solicitation Agreement
description: A restriction on recruiting a former employer's other employees after leaving — a narrower, distinct question from a noncompete, and one where courts genuinely disagree.

title: Whistleblower Policy
description: States the federal anti-retaliation protections that apply to reports of securities fraud and related misconduct — Sarbanes-Oxley and, separately, Dodd-Frank — and sets an internal reporting channel.

title: Single-Member LLC Operating Agreement
description: The internal governance document for a one-owner LLC — states the default federal tax treatment, what it actually takes to elect a different one, the real, sourced limits of the liability shield, records access rights, and what actually happens to the company when its sole member dies.

title: Multi-Member LLC Operating Agreement
description: Governance for a multi-owner LLC — membership, contributions, and voting, plus the real, sourced default rules on tax treatment (including how and when to elect a different one), liability, member fiduciary duties, records access, and the actual statutory dissolution triggers that apply if the members don't spell out their own.

title: Corporate Bylaws
description: Internal governance for a corporation — shareholder and board meeting defaults, written consent, cumulative voting, director removal, officer roles, and indemnification, with the real statutory floors and ceilings under quorum and voting thresholds, board meeting notice requirements, and when indemnification stops being optional — not just fill-in-the-blank numbers.

title: S Corporation Election Overview
description: The federal eligibility test, unanimous shareholder consent requirement, filing deadline, revocation, and the ways S status can be lost or restored — including the family-attribution rule for counting shareholders and what doesn't count as a second class of stock — closes the loop the LLC and Bylaws documents leave open.

title: Buy-Sell Agreement
description: What happens to an owner's interest on death, disability, divorce, or departure — a rider to an LLC operating agreement or corporate bylaws, with the real default rules that apply if this gap is left open, and what it actually takes to make the restriction enforceable against an outside transferee.

title: Residential Lease Agreement
description: A lease with the real, sourced specifics on what a landlord can do — down to the exact tenantability checklist, the pre-move-out inspection right, the 2025 photo-documentation law, and the specific notice required before entering.

title: Last Will and Testament
description: A will with the real, sourced specifics on what makes one legally valid — the two-part capacity test, the exact signing requirements, the handwritten-will fallback, what a later divorce or a child born afterward does to it, and the statutory fallback for who administers an estate with no executor named.

title: Financial Power of Attorney
description: A durable power of attorney with the real, sourced specifics on when it takes effect, what a general grant of authority actually covers, the powers that need express authorization even under a broad grant, and how a bank or other third party is required to treat an agent acting under it.

title: Advance Health Care Directive
description: A health care directive with the real, sourced specifics on who can and can't witness it, when an agent's authority actually takes effect, the real limits on what an agent can decide, how revocation works differently for the agent designation than for everything else, and a provider's duty to comply or transfer care.

title: Revocable Living Trust
description: A revocable living trust with the real, sourced specifics on how it's created, revoked, and administered — and a fact this document puts up front rather than burying: a trust holds only the property actually, correctly transferred into it. Real property needs its own recorded deed into the trustee's name; property never transferred stays outside the trust and subject to probate, which is why this document is typically paired with a pour-over will (this corpus's own Last Will and Testament) rather than relied on alone.

fields.placeholder: The Jordan Alex Lee Revocable Living Trust

fields.label: Residuary beneficiary
fields.placeholder: Jordan Alex Lee's children, in equal shares

title: HIPAA Authorization
description: A standalone medical-information release authorization, with the real, sourced specifics on the exact statements and elements federal law requires it to contain, how revocation works, and what makes a signed authorization invalid — distinct from naming a health care decision-making agent.

title: Codicil to a Will
description: A narrow, sourced amendment to an existing will — what makes a codicil legally distinct from a new will, why it must independently satisfy the same signing formalities, and the real, honest gap in California's statute on republication and multi-document revocation.

title: Nomination of Guardian for Minor Children
description: A standalone guardian nomination separate from a will, with the real, sourced specifics on how a nomination can be timed or conditioned, a minor's own statutory role, and California's no-court Caregiver's Authorization Affidavit mechanism — what it allows, what it doesn't, and when it stops being valid.

title: Premarital Agreement
description: A prenup with the real, sourced specifics on what it can and can't control — the spousal-support waiver's actual conditions, the two-part test that can unwind the whole agreement, and the specific seven-day and independent-counsel rules that determine whether it was signed voluntarily in the eyes of a court.

title: Marital Settlement Agreement
description: A divorce settlement with the real, sourced specifics on the equal-division default rule and its written-agreement exception, the community-vs-separate property line, the date-of-separation test that decides which earnings count, the actual spousal-support factor list, and the 10-year rule that keeps a court's jurisdiction over support open indefinitely.

title: Postnuptial Agreement
description: A property agreement between spouses already married, with the real, sourced specifics on the interspousal fiduciary duty, the transmutation writing requirement that actually controls whether it works, the personal-gift exception, and the real, disclosed gap between this and a premarital agreement's spousal-support waiver rules.

title: Parenting Plan
description: A custody and visitation agreement with the real, sourced specifics on the difference between legal and physical custody, the actual best-interest factor list, the state's stated priority when child safety and frequent contact conflict, the domestic-violence rebuttable presumption, and why a parents' own agreement is evidence for a court, not a self-executing order.

title: Child Support Agreement
description: A child support agreement with the real, sourced specifics on the guideline formula that makes an amount presumptively correct, the enumerated grounds for departing from it, the exact conditions required for a valid below-guideline stipulation, the mandatory-vs-discretionary add-on expense distinction, and the automatic earnings assignment that attaches to a court-ordered amount.

title: Domestic Partnership Declaration
description: A domestic partnership declaration with the real, sourced specifics on the current eligibility requirements (updated by a 2020 law that removed the old same-sex-only and age-62 restrictions), the sweeping same-rights-as-spouses statute, the two ways to end a partnership, and how a later marriage between the same partners is actually handled.

title: Voluntary Declaration of Parentage
description: A voluntary parentage declaration with the real, sourced specifics on its judgment-equivalent legal effect, the exact signing and witnessing requirements, the 60-day rescission window, the narrower two-year outer deadline for a later challenge, and what the declaration does and doesn't establish beyond parentage itself.

description: California's separate, often-overlooked requirement to notify a departing employee of a change in their employment relationship and to supply the EDD's unemployment-benefits pamphlet — distinct from this project's Termination/Separation Letter and WARN Act Layoff Notice documents.

title: COBRA Election Notice

title: Sublease Agreement
description: A sublease between an existing tenant and a new subtenant -- distinguishing assignment from sublease, confirming the sublessor's continuing liability to the original landlord, and explaining that California's statutory landlord-consent-to-transfer chapter applies only to nonresidential leases, so a residential sublease's rights turn on the master lease's own terms.

title: Copyright Assignment Agreement
description: An independent creator or freelancer's assignment of copyright ownership in a specific work to the hiring party -- distinct from this project's employment-context Invention Assignment & Confidentiality Agreement, since most freelance work is not automatically "work made for hire" and requires a signed assignment to actually transfer ownership.

title: Final Wage Payment / Waiting-Time Penalty Demand Letter
description: An employee-side demand letter for unpaid final wages and California's waiting-time penalty -- the statutory deadlines for final pay, how the penalty accrues and its 30-day cap, the 'willful' standard courts apply, and the filing deadline -- distinct from this project's employer-facing Termination/Separation Letter.

title: LLC Dissolution and Cancellation
description: The actual statutory winding-up and cancellation filing process that formally terminates an LLC's existence with the California Secretary of State -- distinct from this project's LLC Operating Agreement documents, which cover only the contractual/statutory triggers for dissolution, not the winding-up conduct or the cancellation filings themselves.
